summary.en: The marker locates the Ming court end of the expedition story. It is a modern city centre, not a measured fifteenth-century departure quay.
summary.zh: 标记定位远航故事中明廷这一端。坐标是现代市中心，不是测得的十五世纪出发码头。

detail.en: Geographic locator only. The site date is a display convention, not a foundation or landing date. Coordinate source: D02.
detail.zh: 仅作地理定位。地点日期是显示约定，不是建城或登陆日期。坐标来源：D02。

summary.en: Fuzhou locates the Fujian coast. This modern regional reference is not a measured fifteenth-century departure quay or proof of landing.
summary.zh: 福州点用于定位福建沿岸。这个现代区域参照不是测得的十五世纪出发码头，也不能证明登陆。

detail.zh: 仅作地理定位。地点日期是显示约定，不是建城或登陆日期。坐标来源：D02。

summary.en: A modern city reference on the Chinese coast. It is included for regional orientation, not as a claim of a fleet landing at this point.
summary.zh: 中国沿岸的现代城市参照点，用于辨认区域，不据此宣称船队曾在这里登陆。

detail.en: Geographic locator only. The site date is a display convention, not a foundation or landing date. Coordinate source: D02.
detail.zh: 仅作地理定位。地点日期是显示约定，不是建城或登陆日期。坐标来源：D02。

summary.en: Melaka had its own Malay rulers and trading interests and served as a staging depot for the fleets. The point locates the modern city, not the depot.
summary.zh: 马六甲有自己的马来统治者和贸易利益，也是船队的仓储据点。坐标定位现代城市，不是仓库实址。

detail.zh: 仅作地理定位。地点日期是显示约定，不是建城或登陆日期。坐标来源：D02。

summary.en: Temasek appears in the later navigation-chart tradition; archaeology also supports a trading settlement before 1819. Singapore city is a regional anchor, not proof of Zheng He landing.
summary.zh: 淡马锡见于后出的航海图传统，考古也支持这里在 1819 年以前已有贸易聚落。新加坡城市点仅作区域定位，不能证明郑和登陆。

detail.zh: 仅作地理定位。地点日期是显示约定，不是建城或登陆日期。坐标来源：D02。

summary.en: Old Port is associated with modern Palembang. The 1407 killing report belongs to this region; the city point is not a measured battle centre.
summary.zh: 旧港在本题对应今天的巨港。1407 年的被杀报告与这一区域相关；城市点不是测得的战斗中心。

detail.en: Geographic locator only. The site date is a display convention, not a foundation or landing date. Coordinate source: D02.
detail.zh: 仅作地理定位。地点日期是显示约定，不是建城或登陆日期。坐标来源：D02。

summary.en: Surabaya is only a Java regional anchor for the 1407 report of Ming troops being killed. The conflict site has not been established here.
summary.zh: 泗水仅作为 1407 年明军被杀报告的爪哇区域参照点。本题没有确定冲突的实址。

summary.en: Kochi, also called Cochin and historically 柯枝, locates an Indian southwest-coast destination in the early expedition accounts. Modern city coordinates do not locate a medieval quay.
summary.zh: 科钦（旧称柯枝）用于定位早期远航记载中的印度西南岸目的地。现代城市坐标不是中世纪码头。

detail.zh: 仅作地理定位。地点日期是显示约定，不是建城或登陆日期。坐标来源：D02。

summary.en: Calicut, now Kozhikode, was an Indian southwest-coast destination. The point locates the modern city in a wider trading region, not a ship position.
summary.zh: 古里，今科泽科德，是印度西南岸目的地。点定位贸易区域中的现代城市，不是船只位置。

detail.en: Geographic locator only. The site date is a display convention, not a foundation or landing date. Coordinate source: D02.
detail.zh: 仅作地理定位。地点日期是显示约定，不是建城或登陆日期。坐标来源：D02。

summary.en: Galle is the findspot of a stele with Chinese, Tamil and Persian texts and a 1409 date. It is not the Sri Lankan ruler’s palace or a known battle site.
summary.zh: 加勒是一方有中文、泰米尔文、波斯文及 1409 年日期的石碑的发现地，不是锡兰统治者的宫殿或已知战场。

detail.zh: 仅作地理定位。地点日期是显示约定，不是建城或登陆日期。坐标来源：D02。

summary.en: Aden is associated with the fifth expedition’s destinations. A modern city point locates the port region; no measured ship track is implied.
summary.zh: 亚丁见于第五航次相关的目的地记载。现代城市点用于定位港口区域，不表示测得的航迹。

detail.en: Geographic locator only. The site date is a display convention, not a foundation or landing date. Coordinate source: D02.

summary.en: Mogadishu appears among the fifth expedition’s East African destinations. An expedition destination does not prove the admiral personally landed here.
summary.zh: 摩加迪沙列在第五航次的东非目的地中。船队目的地不能据此变成统帅本人登陆的证明。

detail.zh: 仅作地理定位。地点日期是显示约定，不是建城或登陆日期。坐标来源：D02。

summary.en: Malindi appears in accounts of the fifth expedition. This modern city locator does not resolve the itinerary of every squadron or person.
summary.zh: 马林迪见于第五航次记载。这个现代城市定位点不能确定每支分队或每个人的行程。

title.zh: 苏门答剌附近区域（今司马威参照）

summary.en: Modern Lhokseumawe is a nearby regional anchor for Samudera’s succession conflict. It is not a located palace, capture site, or the whole island of Sumatra.
summary.zh: 今天的司马威是苏门答剌继位冲突的附近区域参照点，不是确定的宫殿或俘获地点；苏门答剌也不等于整座苏门答腊岛。

title.zh: 孟加拉区域（今达卡参照）

summary.en: Dhaka locates the Bengal region associated with the king’s giraffe gift in 1414. It is not the documented place where the animal boarded a ship.
summary.zh: 达卡用于定位 1414 年国王赠送长颈鹿所涉及的孟加拉区域，不是文献确定的动物装船地点。

detail.en: Geographic locator only. The site date is a display convention, not a foundation or landing date. Coordinate source: D02.
detail.zh: 仅作地理定位。地点日期是显示约定，不是建城或登陆日期。坐标来源：D02。

summary.en: The point is GeoNames 131231 on Hormuz island, an expedition destination in the Persian Gulf. Bandar Abbas on the mainland has not been substituted for the island.
summary.zh: 坐标取自 GeoNames 131231，位于作为远航目的地的波斯湾霍尔木兹岛上；没有用大陆上的阿巴斯港替代岛上城镇。

detail.zh: 仅作地理定位。地点日期是显示约定，不是建城或登陆日期。坐标来源：D03。

summary.en: Kilwa Kisiwani represents the wider Swahili trading world. Its Chinese porcelain is evidence of exchange; this topic does not claim a confirmed fleet stop here.
summary.zh: 基尔瓦代表更广阔的斯瓦希里贸易世界。这里的中国瓷器是交换的证据；本题不把这里列成确认的船队停靠点。

detail.zh: 仅作地理定位。地点日期是显示约定，不是建城或登陆日期。坐标来源：D04。

summary.en: First expedition: conventionally dated 1405–1407. Dates distinguish the expedition sequence; they do not locate a ship at this point on an exact day.
summary.zh: 第一次远航通常标为 1405—1407 年。日期用于区分航次，不表示某一天有船只停在这个坐标。

detail.en: The marker locates the Ming court end of the expedition story. It is a modern city centre, not a measured fifteenth-century departure quay.
detail.zh: 标记定位远航故事中明廷这一端。坐标是现代市中心，不是测得的十五世纪出发码头。

summary.en: Ming records reported 5,000 people killed in the 1407 action against Chen Zuyi at Old Port. This is a reported figure, not an independently verified count.
summary.zh: 明方记录报告，1407 年旧港对陈祖义的行动中有 5,000 人被杀。这是报告数字，不是独立核实的人数。

detail.en: Old Port is associated with modern Palembang. The 1407 killing report belongs to this region; the city point is not a measured battle centre. The surviving report does not establish a civilian/combatant breakdown or a known total for other losses.
detail.zh: 城市点仅定位旧港区域，不是测得的战斗中心。现有报告不能确定平民与战斗人员的比例，也不能补出其他损失总数。

summary.en: Wade cites Ming records reporting that 170 Ming troops were killed in Java in 1407. No total for local deaths is established here.
summary.zh: 韦德（Geoff Wade）引述明方记录，报告 1407 年有 170 名明军在爪哇被杀。本题没有确定当地人的死亡总数。

detail.en: Surabaya is only a Java regional anchor for the 1407 report of Ming troops being killed. The conflict site has not been established here.
detail.zh: 泗水仅作为 1407 年明军被杀报告的爪哇区域参照点。本题没有确定冲突的实址。

summary.en: Second expedition: conventionally dated 1407–1409. Dates distinguish the expedition sequence; they do not locate a ship at this point on an exact day.
summary.zh: 第二次远航通常标为 1407—1409 年。日期用于区分航次，不表示某一天有船只停在这个坐标。

detail.en: Columbia's account places the 1407–1409 expedition at Calicut for a new king's inauguration. It says Zheng He organised the expedition but did not lead it in person. The modern Kozhikode city point marks that destination, not a ship position or a known ceremony site.
detail.zh: 哥伦比亚大学资料记述，1407—1409 年的船队前往古里参加新王即位典礼，并说明郑和组织了这次远航，却没有亲自率队。今天科泽科德的城市坐标表示这一目的地，不是船只位置或已知的典礼实址。

summary.en: Third expedition: conventionally dated 1409–1411. Dates distinguish the expedition sequence; they do not locate a ship at this point on an exact day.
summary.zh: 第三次远航通常标为 1409—1411 年。日期用于区分航次，不表示某一天有船只停在这个坐标。

detail.en: The marker locates the Ming court end of the expedition story. It is a modern city centre, not a measured fifteenth-century departure quay.
detail.zh: 标记定位远航故事中明廷这一端。坐标是现代市中心，不是测得的十五世纪出发码头。

title.en: Captives taken to the Ming court

summary.en: After fighting in Sri Lanka, Zheng He’s forces took a ruler and members of his family to the Ming court in 1411. Nanjing marks the destination of captivity.
summary.zh: 锡兰发生战事后，郑和的军队在 1411 年将一位统治者及家人带到明廷。南京点表示被带至的一端。

detail.en: The marker locates the Ming court end of the expedition story. It is a modern city centre, not a measured fifteenth-century departure quay.
detail.zh: 标记定位远航故事中明廷这一端。坐标是现代市中心，不是测得的十五世纪出发码头。

summary.en: Fourth expedition: conventionally dated 1413–1415. Dates distinguish the expedition sequence; they do not locate a ship at this point on an exact day.
summary.zh: 第四次远航通常标为 1413—1415 年。日期用于区分航次，不表示某一天有船只停在这个坐标。

detail.en: The marker locates the Ming court end of the expedition story. It is a modern city centre, not a measured fifteenth-century departure quay.
detail.zh: 标记定位远航故事中明廷这一端。坐标是现代市中心，不是测得的十五世纪出发码头。

summary.en: A giraffe was presented to Yongle in 1414 as a gift from the king of Bengal. Courtiers linked it to the auspicious qilin.
summary.zh: 1414 年，孟加拉国王赠送的长颈鹿被呈给永乐帝；宫廷将它与祥瑞麒麟联系起来。

detail.en: The marker locates the Ming court end of the expedition story. It is a modern city centre, not a measured fifteenth-century departure quay.
detail.zh: 标记定位远航故事中明廷这一端。坐标是现代市中心，不是测得的十五世纪出发码头。

summary.en: Zheng He captured a claimant in Samudera’s succession conflict in 1415 and took him to China. Accounts of the dispute conflict.
summary.zh: 1415 年，郑和在苏门答剌继位冲突中俘获一位争夺统治权的人，将他带往中国。争端记载互有矛盾。

detail.en: Modern Lhokseumawe is a nearby regional anchor for Samudera’s succession conflict. It is not a located palace, capture site, or the whole island of Sumatra.
detail.zh: 今天的司马威是苏门答剌继位冲突的附近区域参照点，不是确定的宫殿或俘获地点；苏门答剌也不等于整座苏门答腊岛。

summary.en: The conventionally dated final expedition ends in 1433. The end of this state-sponsored sequence did not end maritime trade.
summary.zh: 通常纪年的最后一次远航在 1433 年结束。这组国家远航的结束不等于海上贸易终止。
